name: Skin, sunlight & bones

primary.label: Hours outdoors in daylight each week

overlay.caption: sunlight on skin → vitamin D → gut takes in calcium → bones

does: Shows skin making vitamin D when daylight reaches it, much less in winter
Shows vitamin D helping the gut take calcium in from food
Shows that milk's calcium is only useful once it is absorbed
doesnt: Measure any real person — the numbers are illustrative teaching values
Account for skin tone, sunscreen, clothing, latitude or vitamin D in food
Say how much sun anyone should get — too much sun burns skin (see The Sunburned Lifeguard)
limits.text: This is a simplified learning model. Real people vary with age, fitness and health. The numbers are illustrative, not measurements of any real person.
limits.wellbeing: Questions about what your own body needs are worth asking a parent or school nurse.
